display_long_description:
Grow crazy plants by day. Things get wild at night!                  

[media]
# Magical Seeds
Plant. Grow. Harvest. Turn tiny seeds into wild, oversized, mutated fruits.

# Mutations
Rainbow. Sun-kissed. Tornado, Acid rain. Weather mutates your plants into rare, powerful versions. Stack those mutations!
[media]
# Plants vs Jeremys
At night, defensive plants protect your garden. Whack wild jeremys with your friends. Beware of BLOOD MOON.


# Garden Gear
Watering can, sprinklers, fruit basket, OG costumes, gloves, hats, shovel. Everything you need to build your dream garden.
[media]
# Pets Coming Soon
Magical creatures that help your garden to get mutations, grow bigger plants!

Become a **GRO BRO: https://discord.gg/gro**
